content: btrfsRaid0 layout completed + enableSwap/swapSize refactor (commit 48ad7bc, 128/128 PASS). btrfsRaid0: dual-disk pure RAID0 (data+metadata), EFI on both disks, 2 LUKS swap partitions (partition 2, swapSize/2 each) gated by enableSwap, root on partition 3 (remainder, no size formulas). Swapfile removed (impossible on RAID0: btrfs SWAPFILE_SUPPORT requires single device + single data profile). dmcrypt keyfile+conf.d after subvol mounts (step 6a), fstab /dev/mapper/swap-*, swap service conditional (fixes latent bug: swap never activated on RAID0). enableSwapfile → enableSwap generic: btrfsStandard keeps swapfile, btrfsRaid0 uses LUKS swap partitions, btrfsStandardServer unchanged (always LUKS swap — user: 'mandatory by design'). New swapSize variable (default auto = 2x RAM) via utils/swap.ResolveSwapSizeMiB (reads /proc/meminfo MemTotal x2, or parses 8G/4096M). swapSize = TOTAL split across partitions. Harness: EnableSwapfile → EnableSwap + SwapSize, swap_status/services_status use cfg.EnableSwap || layout==Server. Verified: raid0 32/32, standard 32/32 (swapfile 7.66GiB), noswap 32/32, server 32/32. Next: btrfsStandardUnencrypted.

enableSwap/swapSize design: swapSize = TOTAL swap size split across partitions (default auto = 2x RAM via /proc/meminfo). btrfsRaid0: swap on partition 2, root on partition 3 (remainder, no size formulas). btrfsStandardServer always LUKS swap (not gated by enableSwap). btrfsStandard keeps swapfile. Swapfile impossible on btrfs RAID0 (SWAPFILE_SUPPORT: single device + single data profile).
